risk_summary: The disclosure identifies substantial exposure to volatile commodity prices, offshore energy spending, contract renewals, inflation, supply-chain disruption, workforce constraints, and COVID-19 effects. It provides some useful operational and cash-flow quantification, but relies heavily on forward-looking and conditional language regarding recovery, contract demand, margin protection, and long-term fundamentals. Debt repayments and approximately $31 million of undiscounted decommissioning obligations create additional liquidity considerations.
